memory_lessons.claim: The sqrtf(T)-sharing rewrite passed the eight varied correctness cases but measured 0.0082144 s versus the 0.0075286 s baseline mean. Sharing alone therefore showed no speed benefit in that measurement; this does not establish how it will perform combined with another rewrite.
memory_lessons.next_experiment: Measure this Horner-only rewrite, then consider a combined Horner and sqrtf-sharing candidate if it passes correctness.

proposal.hypothesis: The prior sqrtf(T)-sharing rewrite was correct but measured slower than baseline. This isolated Horner rewrite preserves the CND coefficients and polynomial while changing its evaluation order; it may reduce intermediate-value pressure or enable efficient contraction, but may also alter rounding or performance. Keep the sqrtf expressions unchanged so the controller can measure this change independently.

retained: Rewrite the supplied CND polynomial in Horner form while preserving its coefficients; leave sqrtf(T) expressions and all other computation unchanged.
